name: Datasets for Deep Data-Driven Reinforcement Learning (D4RL)
description: A benchmark suite of offline reinforcement-learning datasets covering locomotion, navigation, manipulation, and other tasks. D4RL provides datasets collected through different policies and environments for evaluating offline RL algorithms; it is a collection of task-specific datasets rather than one uniform table.
citation: Fu, J., Kumar, A., Nachum, O., Tucker, G., & Levine, S. (2020). D4RL: Datasets for Deep Data-Driven Reinforcement Learning. arXiv:2004.07219. https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.07219

license.identifier: Varies by dataset and source (not a standard SPDX identifier)
license.notes: D4RL is a benchmark and distribution of datasets assembled from multiple sources; no single standard SPDX license identifier applies to the full collection. Review the license and terms for each dataset, environment, and underlying source before use or redistribution.
